```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# position table, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
# The position path is a contract-checked pipeline target, read from the
# targets store rather than the DuckDB (decision 0041).
pp <- targets::tar_read(position_path, store = file.path(root, "_targets"))
rec_levels <- setdiff(harmonized_position_levels(), "Position not recorded")
```

```{r}
#| label: stay-by-group
# A linked recruit counts when he has a recorded high school group and a
# recorded college group; the overall share is every such recruit together.
hs <- pp |>
  filter(
    hs_linked,
    !is.na(hs_group), hs_group != "Position not recorded",
    college_groups > 0, !is.na(college_modal_group)
  )
hs_overall <- mean(hs$hs_group == hs$college_modal_group)
hs_stay <- hs |>
  group_by(hs_group) |>
  summarise(
    recruits = n(),
    stayed = sum(hs_group == college_modal_group),
    stay_share = stayed / recruits,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    hs_group = factor(hs_group, levels = hs_group[order(stay_share)]),
    tip = sprintf(
      "%s: %s of %s kept their group (%.1f%%)",
      hs_group,
      formatC(stayed, big.mark = ",", format = "d"),
      formatC(recruits, big.mark = ",", format = "d"),
      100 * stay_share
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
# Each high school group's share of recruits who played the same group in
# college, against the overall share (dashed line).
p <- ggplot(hs_stay, aes(100 * stay_share, hs_group)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(fill = hs_group, tooltip = tip, data_id = as.character(hs_group)),
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 100 * hs_overall, linetype = "dashed", colour = "#111827") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf(
      "%.1f%% of %s",
      100 * stay_share,
      formatC(recruits, big.mark = ",", format = "d")
    )),
    hjust = -0.1,
    size = 4.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = position_palette(), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x), limits = c(0, 110), breaks = seq(0, 100, 25)) +
  labs(
    title = "Recruits who kept their position group",
    subtitle = "Share keeping their group; dashed: overall",
    x = "Share who kept their group (%)",
    y = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "position-group-hs-to-college", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: grid
# Where each high school group's recruits went in college: every row sums to
# one hundred percent of that group's recruits.
flow <- hs |>
  count(hs_group, college_modal_group, name = "moves") |>
  tidyr::complete(
    hs_group = rec_levels,
    college_modal_group = rec_levels,
    fill = list(moves = 0L)
  ) |>
  group_by(hs_group) |>
  mutate(row_share = moves / pmax(sum(moves), 1L)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    hs_group = factor(hs_group, levels = rev(rec_levels)),
    college_modal_group = factor(college_modal_group, levels = rec_levels)
  )

p_flow <- ggplot(flow, aes(college_modal_group, hs_group, fill = row_share)) +
  geom_tile_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "High school %s, college %s: %s recruits (%.0f%% of the %s group)",
        as.character(hs_group),
        as.character(college_modal_group),
        formatC(moves, big.mark = ",", format = "d"),
        100 * row_share,
        as.character(hs_group)
      ),
      data_id = paste(hs_group, college_modal_group)
    ),
    colour = "white"
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#F3F4F6",
    high = "#374151",
    limits = c(0, 1),
    labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * x),
    name = "Share of the high school group"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Where each high school group's recruits played",
    subtitle = "Share of each high school group by college position group",
    x = "College position group",
    y = "High school position group",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )
card_interactive(p_flow)
```
